title: Call for Sponsors & Registration Now Open!
body:
在全体大会中将提供英文至中文之即时翻译。 要得到更多信息， 请查阅注册信息页。

Call for Sponsors

The Hong Kong Summit sponsorship agreement is now available to sign, and sponsorships will be sold on a first-come, first-serve basis.  Thank you for your support! 

Before submitting the agreement, please make sure you have read the Steps to Becoming a Sponsor and viewed the full Sponsorship Prospectus. After signing the agreement, please check your email to make sure you confirm submission via Echosign. Please contact events@openstack.org if you have any questions.

Call for Speakers

The call for speakers is now CLOSED, the deadline to submit was July 31, 2013.

Summit attendees will have the opportunity rate all of the speaking submissions to help determine which presentations are the best fit for our Summit. We will open the voting system in August with the goal of locking the agenda by mid-September 2013.

Registration

Registration is now open. 

Note that have TWO tiers of passes available.  See Format and Pricing for more details.

archiveNotice: Archived event content. Dates, registration information and policies below apply to this historical Summit.
